# Google Fonts Adapter
Canonical resource: `https://fonts.google.com/`.

Use Google Fonts for typography discovery and verification. Confirm the selected family, available weights/styles or variable axes, and license/source metadata before implementation. Respect performance, privacy, self-hosting, and offline requirements of the target project.

Do not claim a font was loaded in the final interface until the built application or page actually resolves it.
